method: Saved file reopened; evaluated per-object BVH, actual world transforms, positive and negative controls. No UE operations. Manifest route polylines specify probe locations only.
limits: Discrete probes, not navigation/physics/continuous swept-volume proof
Walking envelope uses 0.30m radius, 1.803m height; three parallel traces at offsets up to -0.75,0,+0.75m, narrowed for declared narrow access links; feet allow <=0.22m authored-grade deviation
Markers representing characters are excluded as intended occupancy references
Low conduits <=0.20m above ground are treated as step-height candidates, not runtime-qualified traversable geometry
